clip_faces_to_frustum: clip mesh faces to a view frustum using clip_faces with a ClipFrustum object and face vertices tensor
create_clip_frustum: create a ClipFrustum object with left, right, top, bottom, znear, zfar clipping plane values for mesh culling
create_clipped_faces: create a ClippedFaces object storing clipped face vertices, mesh indices, and barycentric conversion tensors
convert_clipped_rasterization_to_origina: convert clipped rasterization fragments back to original unclipped mesh face indices and barycentric coordinates
get_culled_faces: find all mesh faces fully outside the view frustum using the internal _get_culled_faces helper function
